From 897d68d4ce7d50ca45a31e10c0e61597257b32d3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dmitry Baryshkov <dmitry.baryshkov@linaro.org>
Date: Fri, 29 Mar 2024 08:15:33 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] usb: typec: ucsi: allow non-partner GET_PDOS for Qualcomm
 devices

The name and description of the USB_NO_PARTNER_PDOS quirk specifies that
only retrieving PDOS of the attached device is crashing. Retrieving PDOS
of the UCSI device works. Fix the condition to limit the workaround only
to is_partner cases.

Fixes: 1d103d6af241 ("usb: typec: ucsi: fix UCSI on buggy Qualcomm devices")
Reviewed-by: Heikki Krogerus <heikki.krogerus@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Dmitry Baryshkov <dmitry.baryshkov@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240329-qcom-ucsi-fixes-v2-1-0f5d37ed04db@linaro.org
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/usb/typec/ucsi/ucsi.c b/drivers/usb/typec/ucsi/ucsi.c
index f7157215eed6..29a7d71c9a40 100644
--- a/drivers/usb/typec/ucsi/ucsi.c
+++ b/drivers/usb/typec/ucsi/ucsi.c
@@ -619,7 +619,8 @@ static int ucsi_read_pdos(struct ucsi_connector *con,
 	u64 command;
 	int ret;
 
-	if (ucsi->quirks & UCSI_NO_PARTNER_PDOS)
+	if (is_partner &&
+	    ucsi->quirks & UCSI_NO_PARTNER_PDOS)
 		return 0;
 
 	command = UCSI_COMMAND(UCSI_GET_PDOS) | UCSI_CONNECTOR_NUMBER(con->num);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/usb/typec/ucsi/ucsi.c`**
   - The condition that checks for the `UCSI_NO_PARTNER_PDOS` quirk has been modified. 
   - The original condition simply checked if the quirk was set, but the new condition now also checks if `is_partner` is true. This change ensures that the workaround for the quirk is only applied when the device is a partner.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `ucsi.c` directly addresses the issue described in the patch's description. By refining the condition to include the `is_partner` check, the patch ensures that the workaround for the `UCSI_NO_PARTNER_PDOS` quirk is only triggered for partner devices, thereby preventing crashes when retrieving PDOS from UCSI devices that are not partners. This change enhances the stability of the UCSI implementation for Qualcomm devices while maintaining functionality for other cases.

Here is the commit message:
usb: typec: ucsi: allow non-partner GET_PDOS for Qualcomm
 devices

The name and description of the USB_NO_PARTNER_PDOS quirk specifies that
only retrieving PDOS of the attached device is crashing. Retrieving PDOS
of the UCSI device works. Fix the condition to limit the workaround only
to is_partner cases.

Fixes: 1d103d6af241 ("usb: typec: ucsi: fix UCSI on buggy Qualcomm devices")
Reviewed-by: Heikki Krogerus <heikki.krogerus@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Dmitry Baryshkov <dmitry.baryshkov@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240329-qcom-ucsi-fixes-v2-1-0f5d37ed04db@linaro.org
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect condition that applied a workaround for the `UCSI_NO_PARTNER_PDOS` quirk to all cases, including non-partner devices. This led to crashes when attempting to retrieve PDOS from devices that were not partners, as the quirk was intended to only affect partner devices. The fix refines the condition to ensure the workaround is only applied when the device is a partner.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int ucsi_read_pdos(struct ucsi_connector *con,
 			  enum typec_role role, int is_partner,
 			  u32 *pdos, int offset, int num_pdos)
 {
 	struct ucsi *ucsi = con->ucsi;
 	u64 command;
 	int ret;
 
-	if (ucsi->quirks & UCSI_NO_PARTNER_PDOS)
+	if (is_partner &&
+	    ucsi->quirks & UCSI_NO_PARTNER_PDOS)
 		return 0;
 
 	command = UCSI_COMMAND(UCSI_GET_PDOS) | UCSI_CONNECTOR_NUMBER(con->num);
 	command |= UCSI_GET_PDOS_PARTNER_PDO(is_partner);
 	command |= UCSI_GET_PDOS_PDO_OFFSET(offset);
 	command |= UCSI_GET_PDOS_NUM_PDOS(num_pdos - 1);
 	command |= is_source(role) ? UCSI_GET_PDOS_SRC_PDOS : 0;
 	ret = ucsi_send_command(ucsi, command, pdos + offset,
 				num_pdos * sizeof(u32));
 	if (ret < 0 && ret != -ETIMEDOUT)
 		dev_err(ucsi->dev, "UCSI_GET_PDOS failed (%d)\n", ret);
 
 	return ret;
 }

```c

Reason:
The condition checks if the `UCSI_NO_PARTNER_PDOS` quirk is set, and if so, it returns 0 without executing the rest of the function. This condition was incorrectly applied to all cases, including non-partner devices, leading to crashes when attempting to retrieve PDOS from devices that were not partners.

The code statements that fix the bug are:

    ucsi->quirks & UCSI_NO_PARTNER_PDOS)
```
Reason:
The fix refines the condition to ensure that the workaround is only applied when the device is a partner (`is_partner` is true). This prevents the function from returning prematurely for non-partner devices, thus avoiding the crashes that occurred previously.
